import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class lets_do_variant1 {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        InputReader in = new InputReader(System.in);
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int b = in.nextInt();
        int[] arr = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            arr[i] = in.nextInt();
        }

        int[] evenPrefix = new int[n];
        int[] oddPrefix = new int[n];
        int evenCount = 0, oddCount = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) {
                evenCount++;
            } else {
                oddCount++;
            }
            evenPrefix[i] = evenCount;
            oddPrefix[i] = oddCount;
        }

        List<Integer> differences = new ArrayList<>();
        int lastEnd = -1;

        for (int i = 1; i < n - 2; i += 2) {
            int evenInRange = evenPrefix[i] - (lastEnd >= 0 ? evenPrefix[lastEnd] : 0);
            int oddInRange = oddPrefix[i] - (lastEnd >= 0 ? oddPrefix[lastEnd] : 0);

            if (evenInRange == oddInRange) {
                differences.add(Math.abs(arr[i + 1] - arr[i]));
            }
        }

        int[] diffArray = new int[differences.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < differences.size(); i++) {
            diffArray[i] = differences.get(i);
        }

        int[] values = new int[diffArray.length];
        Arrays.fill(values, 1);

        int[][] dp = new int[diffArray.length + 1][b + 1];

        for (int i = 1; i <= diffArray.length; i++) {
            for (int w = 0; w <= b; w++) {
                if (diffArray[i - 1] <= w) {
                    dp[i][w] = Math.max(values[i - 1] + dp[i - 1][w - diffArray[i - 1]], dp[i - 1][w]);
                } else {
                    dp[i][w] = dp[i - 1][w];
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(dp[diffArray.length][b]);
    }

    static class InputReader {
        private final InputStream stream;
        private final byte[] buffer = new byte[1024];
        private int ptr = 0;
        private int len = 0;

        public InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        private int read() throws IOException {
            if (ptr >= len) {
                ptr = 0;
                len = stream.read(buffer);
                if (len <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buffer[ptr++];
        }

        private boolean isWhitespace(int c) {
            return c <= ' ' || c == -1;
        }

        public int nextInt() throws IOException {
            int c;
            while (isWhitespace(c = read())) {}
            int sign = 1;
            if (c == '-') {
                sign = -1;
                c = read();
            }
            int val = 0;
            while (!isWhitespace(c)) {
                val = val * 10 + c - '0';
                c = read();
            }
            return val * sign;
        }

        public long nextLong() throws IOException {
            int c;
            while (isWhitespace(c = read())) {}
            int sign = 1;
            if (c == '-') {
                sign = -1;
                c = read();
            }
            long val = 0;
            while (!isWhitespace(c)) {
                val = val * 10 + c - '0';
                c = read();
            }
            return val * sign;
        }

        public String next() throws IOException {
            int c;
            while (isWhitespace(c = read())) {}
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            while (!isWhitespace(c)) {
                sb.append((char) c);
                c = read();
            }
            return sb.toString();
        }
